resources.string: View only. Use Pad and Keys to control the PC.
The PC does not share its screen

Only the owner of the PC can allow it. On the PC, open the Beckon console and type: screen on. Or create an empty file named allow-screen-view in the folder AppData\\Roaming\\Beckon in your user folder. Then try again.
Showing the screen works over Wi‑Fi with a Windows PC that has this version of Beckon.
The PC could not copy its screen
This happens while the PC is locked or shows a system permission window. Unlock it and try again.
Check that the PC is on and on the same Wi‑Fi, then try again.
